<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 18"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Elemental Apotheosis](/Feats.aspx?ID=4203) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 23

**Prerequisites**
[Nourishing Gate](/Feats.aspx?ID=4200); exactly one kinetic element

</column>

---

You take on an elemental countenance, appearing like a type of elemental of your element. You gain any Speeds listed in the [_elemental form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=98) spell for your element and gain [darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415) if you don't already have it. You also gain the [elemental](/Traits.aspx?ID=57) trait and the trait of your chosen element.
name: Elemental Apotheosis
prerequisite: Nourishing Gate; exactly one kinetic element
